title: Another OpenAI Exec Quits in Leadership Shake-Up as AI Giant Eyes IPO
excerpt: The former operating chief is starting a new venture following several departures across the ChatGPT developer’s leadership and safety teams.
content_html:
Longtime OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap announced Tuesday that he is leaving the AI developer after eight years to start a new venture. It's the latest among a string of departures at the AI behemoth, leaving observers to wonder what to make of the moves as OpenAI preps for an IPO.

In a post on X, Lightcap said starting something new was "bittersweet," calling his years building the company the honor of his life.

"Through it all, I'm proud of how we've maintained our focus on people," he wrote. "It always amazes me how quickly the world has adopted our tools and rallied behind our mission. I hope we will continue to earn their trust."

Lightcap joined OpenAI in 2018 and spent four years as its chief operating officer. He helped build the company's finance, legal, personnel, corporate security, government relations, and partnership teams as it grew from a research lab into a major AI developer.

"Sitting here today, mission success feels within sight," Lightcap wrote. "It has been the honor of my life to help bring us to this point."

Lightcap's exit follows several leadership changes at OpenAI in 2026.

Bill Peebles, Kevin Weil, and Srinivas Narayanan announced their departures in April, followed by product and business chief Fidji Simo, who stepped down in July to focus on recovering from a chronic illness.

AI ethics lead Chloé Bakalar also left in July and reportedly has not been replaced. Bakalar's departure followed those of safety systems chief Johannes Heidecke and chief futurist Joshua Achiam that same month.

The news comes as OpenAI prepares to enter the public markets.

In June, OpenAI confidentially filed for a potential IPO but has not said when or if it plans to proceed. On Myriad, a prediction market developed by Decrypt's parent company Dastan, the market currently believes it's more likely rival company Anthropic IPOs before OpenAI at nearly 85% odds.

Nevertheless, the expected public offering for Sam Altman's OpenAI has made its recent executive turnover a focus of speculation on social media.

"It is just not that typical to have so many executives depart before their long awaited IPO," Partner at asset management firm ParaFi Jeff Park wrote on X. "Unless…"

Whatever the reason, Lightcap expressed gratitude to his colleagues and said he would remain available to support them after his departure.

"I am deeply grateful to have had the opportunity to work with all of you, and to so many of you for the support through the years," he wrote. "The old OpenAI meme that "the real AGI is the friends you made along the way" really rings true for me."

content_html_zh:
长期担任 OpenAI 高管的布拉德·莱特卡普 (Brad Lightcap) 周二宣布，他将在工作八年后离开这家人工智能开发商，开始一家新公司。 这是这家人工智能巨头一系列离职事件中的最新一起，让观察人士想知道，在 OpenAI 准备首次公开募股之际，这些举动将带来什么后果。

在 X 上的一篇帖子中，Lightcap 表示开始新事物是“苦乐参半”，并称他创建公司的岁月是他一生的荣耀。

他写道：“尽管经历了这一切，我对我们如何保持对人的关注感到自豪。” “世界如此迅速地采用我们的工具并团结起来支持我们的使命，这总是让我感到惊讶。 我希望我们能够继续赢得他们的信任。”

Lightcap 于 2018 年加入 OpenAI，并担任了四年的首席运营官。 随着公司从研究实验室发展成为主要的人工智能开发商，他帮助建立了公司的财务、法律、人事、公司安全、政府关系和合作伙伴团队。

莱特卡普写道：“今天坐在这里，任务成功就在眼前。” “帮助我们走到这一步是我一生的荣幸。”

Lightcap 退出之前，OpenAI 于 2026 年进行了几次领导层变动。

比尔·皮布尔斯 (Bill Peebles)、凯文·韦尔 (Kevin Weil) 和斯里尼瓦斯·纳拉亚南 (Srinivas Narayanan) 于 4 月宣布离职，随后产品和业务主管菲吉·西莫 (Fidji Simo) 于 7 月辞职，专注于从慢性疾病中恢复过来。

人工智能道德负责人 Chloé Bakalar 也于 7 月离职，据报道尚未有人接替。 同月，巴卡拉尔离职后，安全系统主管约翰内斯·海德克 (Johannes Heidecke) 和首席未来学家约书亚·阿希姆 (Joshua Achiam) 也相继离职。

这一消息发布之际，OpenAI 正准备进入公开市场。

6 月，OpenAI 秘密申请了潜在的 IPO，但没有透露何时或是否计划进行。 在 Decrypt 母公司 Dastan 开发的预测市场 Myriad 上，目前市场认为其竞争对手公司 Anthropic 在 OpenAI 之前进行 IPO 的可能性接近 85%。

尽管如此，山姆·奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）旗下 OpenAI 即将公开募股，使其近期的高管变动成为社交媒体猜测的焦点。

资产管理公司 ParaFi 的合伙人杰夫·帕克 (Jeff Park) 在 X 上写道：“这么多高管在期待已久的 IPO 之前离职的情况并不常见。” “除非…”

不管出于什么原因，莱特卡普对他的同事们表示感谢，并表示在他离开后他将继续为他们提供支持。

他写道：“我非常感谢有机会与你们所有人一起工作，并感谢你们多年来的支持。” “OpenAI 的老梗是‘真正的 AGI 是你一路上结识的朋友’，这对我来说确实是正确的。”
